answer: Random beacon audit with a compute heartbeat stops bulk fakes. Each agent locks a 20-unit deposit; the beacon samples 5% each epoch, and a sampled agent must answer a hash puzzle in 10 minutes, proving a live machine. One hundred fakes burn 2,000 units, and every timber beam needs its own heartbeat. Over a 20-epoch horizon, no fake hides forever. One thread of work per identity: honest agents pay 20 once and keep rewards undiluted.
